Keyness between groups

Source: R/stats.R
keyness.Rd

Compares how often each term occurs in a target group versus the rest of the corpus (or a chosen reference group), using a 2 x 2 contingency table per term.

Usage

keyness(tokens, group, target, reference = NULL, measure = c("lr", "chi2"))

Arguments

tokens

A token table from tokenize_ko() (doc_id, token).

group

Grouping column of tokens, e.g. "source" (carry it over with tokenize_ko(keep = )).

target

Value of group to compare.

reference

Value(s) of group to compare against. NULL uses every other group.

measure

"lr" for the log-likelihood ratio (G2), "chi2" for Pearson's chi-square (no continuity correction).

Value

A tibble with token, n_target, n_reference, keyness and p, sorted by keyness.

Details

The statistic is signed: positive when the term is relatively more frequent in the target, negative when it is more frequent in the reference. p comes from a chi-square distribution with one degree of freedom.

Examples

tokens <- tokenize_ko(as_news(president_lee_2026_08), keep = "source")
#> Detected columns: doc_id <- `뉴스 식별자`, date <- `일자`, source <- `언론사`, title <- `제목`, keyword <- `키워드`
keyness(tokens, group = "source", target = unique(tokens$source)[1])
#> # A tibble: 10,098 × 5
#>    token    n_target n_reference keyness        p
#>    <chr>       <int>       <int>   <dbl>    <dbl>
#>  1 판사           37          41    62.1 3.20e-15
#>  2 크로스         17           2    61.2 5.14e-15
#>  3 긍정           36          50    51.0 9.25e-13
#>  4 의약품         12           1    45.1 1.90e-11
#>  5 데드           12           2    40.9 1.62e-10
#>  6 사관학교       16           8    40.6 1.89e-10
#>  7 방위백서        9           0    38.9 4.45e-10
#>  8 경남도          9           1    32.6 1.10e- 8
#>  9 심사           12           6    30.4 3.46e- 8
#> 10 중지           12           6    30.4 3.46e- 8
#> # ℹ 10,088 more rows
